grasp.rationale: For grasping the marker, the interaction point should be at the center of the body, which provides the best grip location. Candidate 0 is the constructed body_center, located at the middle of the marker body - the optimal point for a stable grasp of the entire object.

transport_active.rationale: The stage requires aligning the marker above the cup opening. The interaction point on the marker should be its body center (constructed body_center), which serves as the reference point for positioning/aligning the marker as a whole object above the cup. This is the centroid of the marker body and best represents where the marker's position is anchored for the alignment task.

insert.rationale: When inserting a marker into a cup, the marker is placed tip-down (or body-end down) into the cup. The constructed body_tip (candidate 1) represents the bottom end of the marker body - the end that would go into the cup first. Looking at the views, candidate 1 is at the cap/tip end of the marker (the white chisel tip end), which is the part that enters the cup opening. This is the interaction point where the marker contacts/enters the cup.

transport_passive.rationale: Candidate 1 is the constructed opening_center point located at the rim/opening of the cup. The stage requires aligning a marker above the cup opening, so the interaction point should be the center of the cup's opening. Candidate 1 consistently appears at the top-center of the cup opening across all views, making it the ideal anchor point for this alignment stage.
